page.overview:
Who is Vellguine de Bourbagne?

Ser Vellguine de Bourbagne is a non-playable character in Final Fantasy XIV: Heavensward. He is the oldest and longest-serving member of the Heavens' Ward.

Known as the Unbreakable Stone Spear for his stern and solemn disposition, Ser Vellguine was the second hand to the former Very Reverened Archimandrite Ser Vaindreau de Rouchemande, and was expected to become the next archimandrite following his death. Believing himself to be better suited to his current position, he declined the archbishop's offer and recommended Ser Zephirin assume the role.

Ser Vellguine, alongside his fellow Heavens' Ward, joined Thordan VII in the Singularity Reactor, after the Warrior of Light defeated both Lahabrea and Igeyorhm. The knights transformed into the Knights of the Round and assisted King Thordan in combat against the Warrior.

Upon defeat, Vellguine and the other knights fell to the ground, and were encompassed in a swell of aetherical light.
